import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long sum = 0;
        long i = n;
        while (i > 0) {
            long y = sc.nextLong();
            sum += y;
            i--;
        }
        System.out.println(sum / n);
        sc.close();
    }
}
